segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So to get measured or to take someone's measurements.
segments.zh: 所以要测量或测量某人的测量值。

segments.en: These are key phrases for buying a tailor-made suit.
segments.zh: 这些是购买量身定制西装的关键短语。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to our dialogue one last time and we'll be back to talk some more.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不上次听我们的对话，我们会回来再谈谈。

segments.en: Hello sir.
segments.zh: 您好，先生。

segments.en: What can I do for you today?
segments.zh: 今天有什么可以帮您？

segments.en: Hello.
segments.zh: 你好。

segments.en: I would like to order a new suit.
segments.zh: 我想订购一套新西装。

segments.en: I have an important interview next week, so I really need to look sharp.
segments.zh: 下周我有个重要的面试，所以一定得穿得精神利落。

segments.en: No problem.
segments.zh: 没问题。

segments.en: We have a broad selection of suits all tailor-made so it will fit perfectly.
segments.zh: 我们有各种各样的西装，所有这些西装都量身定制，因此非常适合。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: I want a three-piece suit, preferably made from Italian cashmere or wool.
segments.zh: 我想要一件三件套的西装，最好用意大利羊绒或羊毛制成。

segments.en: Very well, sir.
segments.zh: 好的，先生。

segments.en: Would you like to have some shirts made also?
segments.zh: 你也想做一些衬衫吗？

segments.en: Sure.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: I'll also take some silver cufflinks and a pair of silk ties.
segments.zh: 我还要一些银色袖扣和一条丝带。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Now, if you will accompany me, we can take your measurements and choose the patterns for your suit and shirts.
segments.zh: 现在，如果您愿意陪我，我们可以测量您的尺寸并为您的西装和衬衫选择图案。

segments.en: So do you have any tailor-made suits, Marco?
segments.zh: 那么你有定制的西装吗，马可？

segments.en: I actually don't.
segments.zh: 我其实没有。

segments.en: I haven't...
segments.zh: 我没有...

segments.en: Here to the office, I never wear a suit.
segments.zh: 到办公室，我从不穿西装。

segments.en: We don't really need to wear suits all fancy.
segments.zh: 我们真的不需要穿西装。

segments.en: And there have been very few occasions where I've needed a suit.
segments.zh: 而且很少有我需要西装的场合。

segments.en: So I actually don't have a suit at the moment.
segments.zh: 所以我现在实际上没有西装。

segments.en: Not even one?
segments.zh: 连一号都没有？

segments.en: Not even one.
segments.zh: 甚至没有之一。

segments.en: Not even off the rack?
segments.zh: 甚至没有离开架子？

segments.en: I have a few at home and I just haven't used them.
segments.zh: 我家里有一些，我只是没有使用它们。

segments.en: And probably they wouldn't fit anymore.
segments.zh: 可能他们不再适合了。

segments.en: This is the problem with getting things tailor-made as well.
segments.zh: 这也是定制东西的问题。

segments.en: The thing is that with a tailor-made suit, usually it's made to get bigger or smaller.
segments.zh: 问题是，搭配量身定制的西装，通常它会变得更大或更小。

segments.en: So maybe the shoulders and the arms are the same, but if you gain weight or you lose weight, the tailor can make those small, small changes.
segments.zh: 所以也许肩膀和手臂是一样的，但如果你体重增加或减轻体重，裁缝可以做出那些微小的改变。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Actually, I had a friend who got some tailor-made jeans.
segments.zh: 实际上，我有一个朋友买了一些量身定制的牛仔裤。

segments.en: And I think that would be nice because sometimes, I don't know, jeans for me, they don't fit well.
segments.zh: 我认为那会很好，因为有时，我不知道，牛仔裤对我来说，它们不合身。

segments.en: Me either.
segments.zh: 我也是。

segments.en: There's a very famous company that does tailor-made jeans that I was thinking about going to because I hate buying jeans off the rack.
segments.zh: 有一家非常有名的公司做量身定制的牛仔裤，我正在考虑去，因为我讨厌从架子上买牛仔裤。

segments.en: Yeah, they usually don't fit.
segments.zh: 是的，他们通常不适合。

segments.en: Either the waist is too...
segments.zh: 无论是腰部还是...

segments.en: If I need a bigger waist, but then everything is too baggy and it just doesn't look right or everything is too small.
segments.zh: 如果我需要一个更大的腰部，但一切都太宽松了，看起来不对，或者一切都太小了。

segments.en: So I think this is a very interesting thing, although I don't know how expensive it would be because getting tailor-made clothes is relatively expensive.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是一件非常有趣的事情，虽然我不知道这会有多贵，因为买到量身定制的衣服相对昂贵。

segments.en: It can be very expensive, although that's usually in America or in Europe.
segments.zh: 它可能非常昂贵，尽管这通常在美国或欧洲。

segments.en: In places like India and China, I think it's much more common to have things made to fit you, tailor-made.
segments.zh: 在印度和中国这样的地方，我认为定制的东西更为常见。

segments.en: This is a very interesting subject and actually, we are wondering if maybe you know a tailor, you are a tailor or you've gotten things tailor-made for you.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的主题，实际上，我们想知道您是否认识裁缝，您是裁缝，或者您已经为您量身定制了一些东西。

segments.en: Maybe you got married recently and you had a tailor-made tuxedo or a tailor-made wedding dress.
segments.zh: 也许你最近结婚了，你有一件量身定制的燕尾服或一件量身定制的婚纱。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So let us know.
segments.zh: 所以，请告诉我们吧。

segments.en: We can be found at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们可以在 englishpod.com 找到。

segments.en: We hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到你。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye, guys.
segments.zh: 再见，各位。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
